text.p: Following are the main stories in Monday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- UMNO party president and Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad reminded members of his party to check social problems especially corruption.
-- The government has no intention of regulating the cellular phone industry to check phone-number frauds, said energy, telecommunications and posts ministry secretary-general Nuraizah Abdul Hamid.
-- Mahathir said he no longer believed in his views that Malays lacked the ability to succeed as he had written in a 1970 book.
-- A planned 2.5 billion ringgit road linking three mountain resorts will be built on a 30m wide corridor instead of 500m to prevent indiscriminate cutting of trees, said Works Minister S.Samy Vellu.
